script.source: The shipped Multi-Fighting init and term toggle the multi-on-one penalty state.
script.runtime: Loaded membership drives the existing interlock penalty calculation and unloading reverses it. The unrecovered native threshold and caller scope remain open.

script.source: The four shipped Sharpshooter callbacks turn ordinary firing-into-melee and short-range melee penalties off on application and restore them on termination.
script.runtime: SharpshooterFreeFire captures loaded membership as both switches. Stale or changed membership must recapture rather than reusing an old penalty decision. Caller distance/count policy remains a separate source-parity item.
